outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot image only; no averaged plot data is shown, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B contains only phase-contrast micrographs; no averaged plot data is shown.

Panel C top shows flow cytometry dot plots (scatter-type data, exempt as individual points ARE the data), and the bottom bar chart displays individual data points (distinct markers: circles, squares, triangles, inverted triangles) overlaid on each bar (n=3 per condition).
Panel D top shows flow cytometry dot plots (scatter-type, exempt), and the bottom bar chart shows individual data points overlaid on the bars (n=3 per condition).
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized gene expression Z-scores; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel F is a western blot image only; no averaged plot data is shown.
Both bar charts in panel G display individual data points (markers such as circles, squares, triangles) overlaid on each bar (n=3 replicates).
Panel H consists of immunofluorescence micrographs only; no averaged plot data is shown.
